text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
The night before the Japan Derby, Duramente 
received an encouraging call from her father. 
Do not overdo it, and come through the race safely.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Jungle Pocket, the horsegirl who had once 
conquered the Japan Derby herself, 
came to speak with Duramente.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket, who aims to be the strongest too, said 
she had come to see the strongest of this era. And she asked: 
--Are you the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
Duramente told her flatly 
that the answer would be clear today.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Notes
text_block_list.text:
When Duramente appeared in the paddock she was calm, 
with the bearing of the strongest about her... 
At last, she takes on the Japan Derby.
